blocks.title: ## SAT/GRE Vocabulary Deck
blocks.subtitle: Expand your lexicon with high-frequency academic words.

blocks.title: Active Recall Tip
blocks.description: Force yourself to mentally define the word or say it aloud before flipping the card. This active retrieval strengthens neural connections far better than passive reading.

cards.back: Lasting for a very short time; transient or fleeting.
Present, appearing, or found everywhere; omnipresent.
Wicked, impious, or villainous; extremely criminal in nature.
A person who acts obsequiously toward someone important in order to gain advantage; a flatterer.
To make something bad or unsatisfactory better; to improve.
Given to sudden and unaccountable changes of mood or behavior; unpredictable.
Having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way; highly destructive.
Reserved or uncommunicative in speech; saying little by habit.
Open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous or deliberately misleading.
Excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters; wordy.
